text: You started a business to do great work.
phonemes: juː stˈɑːɹɾᵻd ɐ bˈɪznəs tə dˈuː ɡɹˈeɪt wˈɜːk.

text: Meet Office Admin. One home for the business behind it.
phonemes: mˈiːt ˈɑːfɪs ˈædmɪn. wˈʌn hˈoʊm fɚðə bˈɪznəs bᵻhˈaɪnd ɪt.

text: Your customers. Your projects. Every detail, in the right place.
phonemes: jʊɹ kˈʌstəmɚz. jʊɹ pɹˈɑːdʒɛkts. ˈɛvɹi diːtˈeɪl, ɪnðə ɹˈaɪt plˈeɪs.

text: From the first estimate to the final invoice.
phonemes: fɹʌmðə fˈɜːst ˈɛstᵻmət tə ðə fˈaɪnəl ˈɪnvɔɪs.

text: Keep the work moving. And see what's coming in.
phonemes: kˈiːp ðə wˈɜːk mˈuːvɪŋ. ænd sˈiː wʌts kˈʌmɪŋ ˈɪn.

text: At your desk. On the job. It's all right there.
phonemes: æt jʊɹ dˈɛsk. ɔnðə dʒˈɑːb. ɪts ˈɔːl ɹˈaɪt ðˈɛɹ.

text: Your costs. Your cash flow. The whole picture.

text: And AIVA. Your assistant, with the context of your work.

text: Ask about a project. Find a decision. Prepare the follow-up.
phonemes: ˈæsk ɐbˌaʊt ɐ pɹˈɑːdʒɛkt. fˈaɪnd ɐ dᵻsˈɪʒən. pɹɪpˈɛɹ ðə fˈɑːloʊˈʌp.

text: A useful next step. Ready for your review.

text: Run the work. Not the runaround.
